title: Fixed-scale execution-signature decomposition at the G09B C1-low-forcing failure
sample_rule: At every scale evaluate h0,h0±d,h0±2d from the immutable accepted origin; record participant status, q, and raw corrector diagnostics for each unique head.
derived_diagnostics: exact G09B signature eligibility per sample
per-field equality against the center signature
accepted substep partition equality against center
stable slope plateaus that span more than one scale
questions: Does C1 negative fail E2 because no status-0 stencil exists, or because status-0 samples differ only in some execution-signature fields?
Which signature fields actually correlate with derivative contamination in the target versus the qualified control?
Can a narrower execution-class criterion be motivated from evidence without retrospectively changing G09B?
hard_rules: No change to G09B estimator or thresholds.
No adaptive scale selection or scale deletion.
Every trial is discarded; accepted revision/time/ledger remain unchanged.
G09C is diagnostic-only and cannot qualify a replacement estimator.
next_if_informative: Preregister a new estimator only after identifying the minimum execution-class fields needed to exclude contaminated derivative samples.
